# @chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit@0.6.0

> TP-Link Omada Controller v6.3 React 19 + Ant Design 6 UI component kit with Light/Dark design tokens, scoped micro-frontend CSS, bundled Figma assets, deterministic Agent Bridge, and zero-build single-file HTML standalone bundle.

## Subpath Entrypoints
- `@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit/core`: Theme (`OmadaProvider`, `useOmadaTheme`, `useRovingFocus`), layout, base `S*` inputs/tables/feedback
- `@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit/blocks`: `SEmulatorShell`, `SFilterTableBlock`, `SInlineRuleEditorLayout`, `SInlineFormRow`, `SDetailInspectorDrawer`, `SMasterDetailSplitBlock`, `SWizardModal`, `SSwitchPortPicker`
- `@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit/charts`: Modular ECharts (`SChart`, `SLineChart`, `SBarChart`, `SDonutChart`, `SSparkChart`, `SDonutSummaryCard`, `SHealthGauge`, `SHealthRadar`, `SHealthTrendBar`, `SChannelUtilization`)
- `@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit/emulator`: Controller v6.3 domain widgets (`STopologyCanvas`, `SAclRuleBuilder`, `SSettingsPageShell`, `STerminalConsole`, `SDevicePortGraphic`, `SPortPanel`)
- `@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit/assets`: `SIcon` (590), `SProductImage` (83), `SIllustration` (122), `SClientIcon` (217), `SBrandAsset` (47), `OmadaLogo`, `SDeviceIcon`
- `@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit/agent`: `OmadaAgentProvider` (`exposeWindowBridge` + WebMCP), `useOmadaAgent`, `useOmadaAgentControl`, `useOmadaAgentAction`, `registerWebMcpTools`, `OMADA_AGENT_TOOLS`, `OMADA_SECRET_MASK`
- `@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit/style.css`: Full stylesheet (includes Tailwind v4 preflight)
- `@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit/style.scoped.css`: Scoped stylesheet without global reset (pair with `<OmadaProvider syncDocumentTheme={false}>`)
- `@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit/standalone`: Browser IIFE bundle (`window.OmadaUI`)

## External Browser Agent Protocol (`window.__OMADA_AGENT__` + WebMCP)
1. **Discover**: Check `Boolean(window.__OMADA_AGENT__)` (or browser WebMCP site tools `snapshot`, `query`, `act` on `document.modelContext`) before taking screenshots or clicking DOM selectors.
2. **Read**: Call `window.__OMADA_AGENT__.snapshot()` for deterministic `{ controls, actions }` (secrets masked as `[REDACTED]`), or `window.__OMADA_AGENT__.query({ kind, text, id })` on large pages.
3. **Operate**: Call `await window.__OMADA_AGENT__.actAsync({ steps: [{ id, action, value }, ...] })` (or sync `act(...)`) to mutate controls, navigate routes, open drawers/modals, and run domain actions in 1 batch call.

## Pinned Single-File HTML CDN URLs
- CSS: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit@0.6.0/dist/style.css`
- JS: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@chenyqthu/omada-ui-kit@0.6.0/dist/standalone.js`
- Babel: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@babel/standalone@7.28.4/babel.min.js`

## Starter Templates & Verification CLI
- Templates (`templates/*.{html,tsx}`): `dashboard`, `inventory`, `acl-rules`, `settings`, `analytics-logs`
- Query CLI: `node skills/omada-ui-kit/scripts/query-catalog.mjs component <Name>`
- Verifier CLI: `node skills/omada-ui-kit/scripts/verify-demo.mjs [--render] <demo.html|Demo.tsx>`
